rationale: The FOPAE report cover requires written authorization for reproduction.
The SISJUR pages are current/historical official dynamic records and are kept pathless to avoid stale vendored legal text.
Only structured factual transcriptions, source fingerprints, and normalized coordinates are committed.

coefficientTableExtract.scope: Physical pages 155–157 (printed 139–141) of the 168-page report — Tablas 7.5, 7.6 and 7.7 with their design curves and parameter keys — extracted so the drawer can draw each attested cell rectangle on the page that states the coefficient. No other page of the report is served, and a citation outside these three keeps its transcription and outbound link with no viewer.
coefficientTableExtract.extractedFrom: The official SIRE bitstream, re-fetched and verified byte for byte against the committed lock (12386790 bytes, SHA-256 74ba7a6a…) before extracting.
coefficientTableExtract.ownerDecision: Ship the three table pages: a cited coefficient the reader cannot see on its own page is a citation they have to take on trust.
coefficientTableExtract.strongerRestrictionThanAnnex: The report's cover requires written authorization for reproduction, which the cartographic annex of the decree does not. This exception is therefore weaker than the annex one and is the first thing independent review should revisit.
coefficientTableExtract.reviewerAction: If the report may not be reproduced, delete the extract and set localPath/localPageMap back to null; the transcription, the page coordinates and the outbound link already stand on their own.

cartographicAnnex.scope: Screen-resolution rasters of the one-sheet Mapa No 2 annex and a crop of its printed legend, shown in the traceability drawer so the engineer can see which zone was selected.
cartographicAnnex.distinctFromLockedSources: This sheet is the cartographic annex of Decreto Distrital 523 de 2010 — D670 Article 1525 preserves the maps as annexes — not the FOPAE final report. The report, whose cover requires written authorization, is still never rendered or bundled; the three locked sources remain pathless.
cartographicAnnex.ownerDecision: Ship the rasters: the coefficients are only traceable if the engineer can see which of the 16 zones was read.
cartographicAnnex.reviewerAction: Independent review may still revisit this. If the annex may not be redistributed, drop the two PNGs and fall back to the outbound link to the decree.
